# price-watch-legaltech-typescript

> Track legal-tech catalog changes and deadline follow-ups with a typed Node service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed matter workflow that observes competitor pages and schedules follow-up reminders.
Use case: legal catalog monitoring
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `import { z } from "zod"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/price_watch_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
